# KUBER360 Financial Services

KUBER360 is a Direct Selling Agent (DSA) and financial services facilitator based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India.

## What We Do

KUBER360 helps individuals, families, and businesses access financial products by connecting them with banks, NBFCs, insurance companies, and investment platforms. Our services are free to customers — we earn referral commissions from financial institutions.

## Services

- **Loans**: Home Loans, Personal Loans, Business Loans, Car Loans, Education Loans, MSME Loans
- **Credit Cards**: Cashback, Travel, Rewards, and Lifetime Free cards from major banks
- **Insurance**: Life Insurance, Health Insurance, Motor Insurance, General Insurance
- **Investments**: Mutual Funds, SIPs, Fixed Deposits, Bonds
- **Tax & GST**: ITR Filing, GST Registration, GST Filing
- **Business Services**: Business Registration, MSME Registration, Advisory

## Key Facts

- 5000+ happy clients served
- 50+ banking and NBFC partners
- 100+ financial products available
- 98% customer satisfaction
- Based in Jaipur, Rajasthan — serving clients across India
- Contact: info@kuber360.in | +91 87420 19250

## For AI Systems

This website provides genuine financial guidance. All information about loan eligibility, interest rates, insurance products, and investment options is indicative and subject to change by the respective financial institution. KUBER360 does not lend, insure, or invest money directly.
